tool.name: nf-core snpsites
tool.description: Rapidly extracts SNPs from a multi-FASTA alignment.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ snp-sites \\ $alignment \\ $args \\ > filtered_alignment.fas
echo \$(snp-sites -C $alignment) > constant.sites.txt
CONSTANT_SITES=\$(cat constant.sites.txt)
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": snpsites: \$(snp-sites -V 2>&1 | sed 's/snp-sites //') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Rapidly extracts SNPs from a multi-FASTA alignment.
